name: my-project-theme
source: Replace with a short description of where these tokens come from (e.g. 'design-system package v1.2.0', 'Figma library X', 'tailwind.config.js').

palette.__comment: Add your hex -> token mappings here, e.g. '#FFFFFF': 'white'. Use uppercase hex. These are exact matches — the extractor flags colors in this map with a ✅ badge.

semanticOverrides.__comment: Add hex -> { token, role } for colors that should map by semantic role even when the RGB distance isn't the closest. Example: '#8FC3C3': { 'token': 'brand30', 'role': 'accent-brand' }. These are flagged with a 🎨 badge and take priority over palette matches.
